description: This file contains a shell script that tests the addition and removal of an iptables rate limiting rule for ICMP echo-request packets. It inserts a rule, verifies its presence, checks counters, and finally cleans up by removing the rule.
calls: iptables -I INPUT 1 -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m limit --limit 1/second --limit-burst 3 -j ACCEPT
iptables -D INPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m limit --limit 1/second --limit-burst 3 -j ACCEPT
